cases.rationale: The filed 10-K identifies Galactic 01 in June 2023 as the start of commercial service; June falls in the second quarter.

basis.quote: In June 2023, 'Galactic 01,' marked the start of commercial service.

cases.rationale: The crewed flight test did not launch until June 5, 2024, so it could not have been completed by December 31, 2023.

basis.quote: The CFT launched on June 5, 2024, and docked with the ISS.

limitations: This is a retrospectively selected, author-curated eight-case pilot, not an independently reviewed, held-out, representative, or deployment benchmark.
The protocol isolates admissible evidence by publication/version cutoff, but it cannot remove post-cutoff knowledge from current model parameters.
Exact-label results from eight cases are descriptive smoke-test results and do not establish a general accuracy improvement.
